items.item: Does not put a synchronous callout in a trigger or before-save context; uses an asynchronous pattern
items.evidence: "after-save record-triggered flow on Order. It calls invocable Apex on its Run Asynchronously path, and that Apex enqueues a Queueable with `Database.AllowsCallouts`"

items.item: Uses a Named Credential (and External Credential) for the endpoint and authentication, with no hard-coded URL or secret
items.evidence: "Endpoint and auth live in a Named Credential plus External Credential... Code calls `callout:ERP/api/orders`. The URL and secrets are never hard-coded"

items.item: Covers failure handling: retries, logging or an error record
items.evidence: "Retry up to 3 to 5 times with backoff... Mark `Failed` with the response body"; `Last_Sync_Error__c`, `Sync_Attempts__c`, scheduled sweep
